@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+"""Credentials missing from a non-empty ``api_config`` must fall back to env vars."""
+
+import importlib
+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+CALLS: list = []
+
+
+class _Recorder:
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        CALLS.append(kwargs)
+
+    def embed(self, *args, **kwargs):  # bound by the VoyageAI vectorizer
+        return None
+
+    multimodal_embed = contextualized_embed = embed
+
+
+def _fake_module(name, **attrs):
+    module = types.ModuleType(name)
+    for key, value in attrs.items():
+        setattr(module, key, value)
+    return module
+
+
+# (id, module, class, env var)
+CASES = [
+    (
+        "cohere-vec",
+        "redisvl.utils.vectorize.text.cohere",
+        "CohereTextVectorizer",
+        "COHERE_API_KEY",
+    ),
+    (
+        "mistral-vec",
+        "redisvl.utils.vectorize.text.mistral",
+        "MistralAITextVectorizer",
+        "MISTRAL_API_KEY",
+    ),
+    (
+        "voyage-vec",
+        "redisvl.utils.vectorize.voyageai",
+        "VoyageAIVectorizer",
+        "VOYAGE_API_KEY",
+    ),
+    (
+        "cohere-rerank",
+        "redisvl.utils.rerank.cohere",
+        "CohereReranker",
+        "COHERE_API_KEY",
+    ),
+    (
+        "voyage-rerank",
+        "redisvl.utils.rerank.voyageai",
+        "VoyageAIReranker",
+        "VOYAGE_API_KEY",
+    ),
+]
+
+
+SIBLINGS = pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "module_name,class_name,env", [c[1:] for c in CASES], ids=[c[0] for c in CASES]
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def fake_clients(monkeypatch):
+    CALLS.clear()
+    for name in (
+        "COHERE_API_KEY",
+        "MISTRAL_API_KEY",
+        "VOYAGE_API_KEY",
+        "GCP_PROJECT_ID",
+        "GCP_LOCATION",
+    ):
+        monkeypatch.delenv(name, raising=False)
+    for name in ("cohere", "voyageai"):
+        monkeypatch.setitem(
+            sys.modules,
+            name,
+            _fake_module(name, Client=_Recorder, AsyncClient=_Recorder),
+        )
+    monkeypatch.setitem(
+        sys.modules, "mistralai", _fake_module("mistralai", Mistral=_Recorder)
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setitem(
+        sys.modules,
+        "vertexai",
+        _fake_module("vertexai", init=lambda **kwargs: CALLS.append(kwargs)),
+    )
+
+
+def _build(module_name, class_name, monkeypatch, **kwargs):
+    cls = getattr(importlib.import_module(module_name), class_name)
+    if "rerank" in module_name:
+        kwargs.setdefault("model", "fake-rerank-model")
+    if hasattr(cls, "_set_model_dims"):
+        monkeypatch.setattr(cls, "_set_model_dims", lambda self: 3)
+    return cls(**kwargs)
+
+
+@SIBLINGS
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("api_config", [None, {}, {"unrelated": 1}, {"api_key": ""}])
+def test_missing_or_empty_api_key_falls_back_to_env(
+    monkeypatch, module_name, class_name, env, api_config
+):
+    monkeypatch.setenv(env, "env-key")
+    _build(module_name, class_name, monkeypatch, api_config=api_config)
+    assert CALLS and all(call["api_key"] == "env-key" for call in CALLS)
+
+
+@SIBLINGS
+def test_api_config_key_wins_over_env(monkeypatch, module_name, class_name, env):
+    monkeypatch.setenv(env, "env-key")
+    _build(module_name, class_name, monkeypatch, api_config={"api_key": "cfg-key"})
+    assert CALLS and all(call["api_key"] == "cfg-key" for call in CALLS)
+
+
+@SIBLINGS
+def test_no_key_anywhere_still_raises(monkeypatch, module_name, class_name, env):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="API key is required"):
+        _build(module_name, class_name, monkeypatch, api_config={"unrelated": 1})
+
+
+def test_vertexai_project_and_location_fall_back_to_env(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID", "env-project")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("GCP_LOCATION", "env-location")
+    _build(
+        "redisvl.utils.vectorize.vertexai",
+        "VertexAIVectorizer",
+        monkeypatch,
+        api_config={"credentials": "creds"},
+    )
+    assert CALLS == [
+        {"project": "env-project", "location": "env-location", "credentials": "creds"}
+    ]
+
+
+def test_vertexai_config_wins_over_env(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("GCP_PROJECT_ID", "env-project")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("GCP_LOCATION", "env-location")
+    _build(
+        "redisvl.utils.vectorize.vertexai",
+        "VertexAIVectorizer",
+        monkeypatch,
+        api_config={"project_id": "cfg-project", "location": "cfg-location"},
+    )
+    assert CALLS[0]["project"] == "cfg-project"
+    assert CALLS[0]["location"] == "cfg-location"

@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+import sys
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+from redisvl.utils.vectorize.text.openai import OpenAITextVectorizer
+
+
+class _Embeddings:
+    def create(self, *, input, model, **kwargs):
+        data = [types.SimpleNamespace(embedding=[1.0, 2.0, 3.0]) for _ in input]
+        return types.SimpleNamespace(data=data)
+
+
+class FakeOpenAI:
+    instances: list = []
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        self.kwargs = kwargs
+        self.embeddings = _Embeddings()
+        FakeOpenAI.instances.append(self)
+
+
+class FakeAsyncOpenAI:
+    instances: list = []
+
+    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
+        self.kwargs = kwargs
+        FakeAsyncOpenAI.instances.append(self)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def fake_openai(monkeypatch):
+    FakeOpenAI.instances = []
+    FakeAsyncOpenAI.instances = []
+    module = types.ModuleType("openai")
+    module.OpenAI = FakeOpenAI
+    module.AsyncOpenAI = FakeAsyncOpenAI
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "openai", module)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", raising=False)
+
+
+def test_api_config_without_api_key_falls_back_to_env(monkeypatch):
+    """A custom base_url must not make OPENAI_API_KEY unreachable."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "env-key")
+    OpenAITextVectorizer(api_config={"base_url": "https://proxy.example.test/v1"})
+
+    for client in (FakeOpenAI.instances[0], FakeAsyncOpenAI.instances[0]):
+        assert client.kwargs["api_key"] == "env-key"
+        assert client.kwargs["base_url"] == "https://proxy.example.test/v1"
+
+
+def test_api_config_api_key_wins_over_env(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "env-key")
+    OpenAITextVectorizer(api_config={"api_key": "cfg-key"})
+
+    assert FakeOpenAI.instances[0].kwargs["api_key"] == "cfg-key"
+    assert FakeAsyncOpenAI.instances[0].kwargs["api_key"] == "cfg-key"
+
+
+def test_api_config_not_mutated():
+    config = {"api_key": "cfg-key", "base_url": "https://proxy.example.test/v1"}
+    OpenAITextVectorizer(api_config=config)
+
+    assert config == {
+        "api_key": "cfg-key",
+        "base_url": "https://proxy.example.test/v1",
+    }
+
+
+def test_missing_api_key_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="OpenAI API key is required"):
+        OpenAITextVectorizer(api_config={"base_url": "https://proxy.example.test/v1"})
+
+
+def test_env_only_without_api_config(monkeypatch):
+    """The default, most common path: no api_config at all."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "env-key")
+    vectorizer = OpenAITextVectorizer()
+
+    assert vectorizer.dims == 3
+    assert FakeOpenAI.instances[0].kwargs["api_key"] == "env-key"
+    assert FakeAsyncOpenAI.instances[0].kwargs["api_key"] == "env-key"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("empty", ["", None])
+def test_empty_api_key_falls_back_to_env(monkeypatch, empty):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("OPENAI_API_KEY", "env-key")
+    OpenAITextVectorizer(api_config={"api_key": empty})
+
+    assert FakeOpenAI.instances[0].kwargs["api_key"] == "env-key"
+    assert FakeAsyncOpenAI.instances[0].kwargs["api_key"] == "env-key"
